video.title: AI欧腐《吸血鬼公爵养猫指南/A Vampire Duke’s Guide to Raising a Cat》
video.desc:
我看上这只猫了就是说
Lucien, a centuries-old vampire duke, takes in Felix, the last cat demon hunted by the entire world. One is cunning and loves teasing his cat; the other is proud, innocent, and quick to bristle. Their chaotic life in the castle soon turns into irresistible attraction—until Felix discovers he may be nothing more than a precious source of blood, shattering their sweet romance.
活了数百年的吸血鬼公爵Lucien，收留了被全世界追捕的最后一只猫妖 Felix。
一个狡黠腹黑，最爱逗弄自己的“小猫”；一个骄傲单纯，一撩就炸毛。两人在城堡里的同居生活鸡飞狗跳，却也在日复一日的相处中，逐渐滋生出无法抗拒的吸引。
直到Felix发现，自己或许从头到尾都不是什么被珍爱的“小猫”，而只是Lucien眼中珍贵的血源。原本甜蜜的恋情，也因此彻底破碎。
